notes: SciCode = NeurIPS 2024 D&B Track. 80 main problems decomposed into 338 subproblems (15 main / 50 sub for dev split, 65 main / 288 sub for test). Entries in results_over_time are grouped by model release month (YYYY-MM); same-month models share an entry. Each result aggregates scores from paper Table 2/3, the official SciCode leaderboard, and Artificial Analysis (where the model is covered). release_date sources: AA API for AA-tracked models, Meta announcements for Llama 3.x (estimated, marked in the per-result note). evaluation.harbor_aligned_metric is left null per template guidance, to be filled after Harbor parity experiments finish.
